internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The geminate root ذ-ر-ر surfaces in the Quran only as nouns (form_inventory = {N:38}); there is no verb anywhere, so no process/action sense is attested. The 38 tokens split cleanly and without overlap into two lexicalized nominal classes that never co-occur, never gloss one another, and share no collocate or referent. Class A ذَرَّة (6 occ, surface *ar~apK) appears exclusively in the fixed idiom مِثْقَال ذَرَّة, denoting the smallest nameable quantity on a weight/magnitude scale used as a threshold-of-notice in divine reckoning (omniscience 10:61/34:3/34:22, justice 4:40, recompense 99:7-8); 10:61 and 34:3 themselves rank it between أَصْغَر and أَكْبَر, so it is a benchmark quantum, not the absolute minimum. Class B ذُرِّيَّة / ذُرِّيَّٰت (32 occ, surface *ur~iy~ap-/*ur~iy~a`t-) denotes progeny, the descending line issuing from a progenitor or stock, scalable from one child (3:38) to many, potentially trans-generational (6:84, 19:58). The only account that would unify 'smallest mote' with 'progeny' is the external etymology (a scatter/seed verb) which is barred by source policy and is attested for neither word in-corpus. Therefore the honest deliverable is two Quran-internally unbridged classes, not one root nucleus; each class is coherent on its own but no shared semantic contribution can be demonstrated.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Root-level: the corpus licenses NO single concrete meaning attestable across both classes; the shared consonantal skeleton is a formal/etymological fact, not a demonstrable semantic identity (same root != one meaning; morphology != semantic identity). Class A (ذَرَّة) does NOT entail life, agency, descent, scattering, an indivisible 'atom', or the absolute minimum (10:61/34:3 append وَلَآ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ); it never stands free of مِثْقَال and never denotes offspring. Class B (ذُرِّيَّة) does NOT entail righteousness/blessing (37:113 مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ; 7:173 disbelieving line), is NOT restricted to humankind (18:50 Iblis's ذُرِّيَّة), is NOT intrinsically plural (3:38 a single granted child), is NOT the progenitor himself but always what issues from him (7:172 مِن ظُهُورِهِمْ), and never denotes a weight/quantity.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 34:3:17:1 (par. 10:61:27:1): مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ ... وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ — here the text itself defines ذَرَّة as a graded point on a magnitude continuum between 'smaller' and 'larger', a pure metrological term. This self-supplied frame is categorially incompatible with the living-descendant sense of ذُرِّيَّة (e.g. 3:38:11:1 ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً, a goodly child), and because the verse fixes its own semantics it cannot be re-read toward the progeny class. No semantic operation maps 'a unit of weight' onto 'a descendant', so this occurrence blocks any single narrow nucleus spanning both classes.

layer_attribution.derivation: No verbal derivation exists (form_inventory={N:38}); the two classes are distinct nominal templates (*ar~apK vs *ur~iy~ap-/*ur~iy~a`t-) preserving the geminate ر, i.e. separate lexicalizations, not inflections of one stem — so QAC tags (uniform N) carry no discriminating signal.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Two lexicalized nominal classes: ذَرَّة (minimal measure-unit, idiom-bound) and ذُرِّيَّة (descending progeny). Each is class-internally coherent; neither generalizes to a shared root value.
